symptom: After GameCore filters discover-locked weapons and passives out of first-run upgrade offers, the v48 300s / 10-seed matrix on seeds 72000-72009 improves substantially but still fails promotion. IdleBot remains at 0.0%, RandomBot returns to 10.0%, CowardBot returns to 10.0%, GreedyXpBot returns to 50.0%, and TankBot returns to 40.0%, all inside their target intervals. KiteBot remains high at 80.0% against a 45%-75% target, BossHunterBot rises too high at 90.0% against a 45%-75% target, ZoneControlBot remains low at 10.0% against a 25%-55% target, and RouteBot remains high at 40.0% against a 10%-35% target.
root_cause: The discover unlock filter removes a major source of first-demo upgrade-pool variance: content intended to be found later no longer enters ordinary run upgrades before discovery. This corrects several low- and mid-skill policy outcomes, but the remaining failure pattern is content balance rather than unlock leakage. The default starter pool still lets high-mobility and boss-focused policies stabilize too reliably, ZoneControlBot lacks a reliable midgame control/survival path, and fixed-route play still benefits from some 210-300 second layouts.
fix: Keep the GameCore unlock filter because it enforces the content contract, but do not promote v48 to simulated_candidates, playtest_candidates, accepted_content, or Runtime formal content. The next v49 repair should stay in the content candidate layer and rebalance the default first-demo pool and frosting-grassland-standard's 210-300 second pressure: lightly reduce high-skill and boss-focused certainty, improve control-route reliability, and trim fixed-route overperformance without repeating the broad side effects seen in earlier v45-v48 wave repairs.
validation: The unlock-filter matrix is recorded in harness/reports/2026-06-03_demo_buildcraft_unlock_filter_v48_matrix_300s_10seed_72000_001/summary.md and metrics.json. The repair is validated as a GameCore rule fix by cargo fmt --check and cargo test -p game_core, but content promotion remains blocked by the four out-of-target Bot families. Future v49 candidates should rerun at least the 300s / 10-seed all-Bot matrix on seeds 72000-72009 and should also validate against a second seed window before any human playtest recommendation.
